### Speak, for Your Servant is Listening
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-jan-29-2010-11625566.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 3:10
Points:
- Removing busyness and digital clutter creates margin to hear God's guidance.
- Samuel responded to God's summons with immediate submission and an open heart.
- Spiritual mentors like Eli help believers discern and confirm God's voice.
- Being still and at rest positions believers to listen attentively to the Lord.

### Waiting Well
Author: Jana Kelley
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/waiting-well-wholly-loved-september-1.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 3:1
Points:
- Waiting is challenging, particularly when the future appears uncertain.
- Samuel served faithfully during a spiritual season when direct divine revelation was rare.
- Consistent obedience during quiet periods prepares the heart to receive God's calling.
- Seasons of apparent silence invite believers to quiet their spirit and tune their ears to God.

### Hindrances to Hearing
Author: Charles F. Stanley
Site: In Touch Ministries
URL: https://www.intouch.org/read/daily-devotions/hindrances-to-hearing
Passage: 1 Samuel 3:1-10
Points:
- A shallow knowledge of God's character prevents believers from recognizing His communication.
- Overfilled schedules and distracted minds crowd out quiet moments needed to hear Him.
- Listening requires faith that the Holy Spirit speaks to believers personally.
- Guilt and unconfessed sin create spiritual static that drowns out God's voice.
- Believers must remain humble enough to welcome divine correction and guidance.

### 4 Things We Can Learn about Hearing God's Voice from Him Calling Samuel
Author: Jennifer Heeren
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/faith/bible-study/4-things-we-can-learn-about-hearing-gods-voice-from-him-calling-samuel.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 3:1-14
Points:
- Discerning God's voice often requires spiritual maturity, patience, and practice.
- God shows patience with our initial confusion and calls until we hear.
- God uses mature spiritual mentors and community counsel to help clarify His will.
- True listening to God's direction must always culminate in faithful obedience.
